title: Shared definitions
description: Value types reached by $ref from the sibling schemas in this folder. Validates nothing on its own, so no document points its $schema here. A name is plain when the type is generic and tool-prefixed when its rule comes from one tool.

nonBlankString.description: Text that is neither empty nor padded with leading or trailing whitespace.

resticTag.description: Restic tag. Restic splits a --tag value on commas, so a comma here would silently turn one tag into two. Leading and trailing whitespace is rejected for the same reason: it survives into the snapshot, where it is invisible and makes the tag impossible to match by eye.

windowsAbsolutePath.description: Absolute Windows path: starts with a %VAR% reference, a drive root (C:\ or C:/), or a UNC share (\\server\share). A relative path is rejected because the consuming script's working directory is not guaranteed. What a %VAR% expands to is not checked here.
